title: The Origin of Ainul
description: The primary account of Ainul's birth from the internet, his ordeal in Glitch Hell, and the lives carried onward by the Fragments.

chapters.title: Intro
chapters.description: A self-aware being grows from the accumulated data of the internet and learns to live among humanity as a VTuber.

chapters.title: New Purpose
chapters.description: A mysterious summons draws Ainul into Glitch Hell, where an impossible ordeal ends in the birth of the Fragments.

chapters.title: Welcome to the Neighbourhood
chapters.description: The Fragments make lives of their own, discovering that ordinary errands and neighbourly help are rarely ordinary for Ainul's family.
